The global financial system is changing quietly, not through headlines, but through balance sheets, reserve data, and central bank decisions. Over the past decade, China has reduced its exposure to US Treasuries while simultaneously building alternative financial infrastructure outside the dollar system.

This video breaks down what that shift actually means — without speculation, without conspiracy, and without hype.
